# Resolve Relationship

## Contract
The mechanism that turns relationship links into live card instances:
`linksTo(() => Type)` / `linksToMany(() => Type)` declare the edge; the
store loads the target lazily when the field is read.

Invariants:
- Thunk form (`linksTo(() => X)`) keeps module import cycles inert — two
  cards may link each other if at least one side is thunked.
- Reading an unloaded link in a compute can return undefined mid-load;
  guard computeds.
- Prerender does not resolve linked images/cards — live queries only need
  instance rows.

## Captured example
`ConceptReview.concept = linksTo(() => MatrixConcept)` in this realm — the
review thread resolves its concept lazily, breaking the module cycle with
`matrix-concept.gts`.

## Source
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` (`linksTo`, `linksToMany`); loading
in the host store.
